title: Emit error for "unknown rule selectors" when explicit-preview-rules=true
body:
After https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/pull/26113, "unknown rule selectors"  emit warning when an invalid rule is select when preview=true.
Would it make sense to emit errors when explicit-preview-rules=true?
I want to enable some preview rules, but I like the validation that I'm not selecting rules with typos

thanks
